title: Calendar
description: Lets the shopper pick a date from a month grid, within a minimum and maximum, starting the week where the locale it is given does, one or several months side by side.

components.Calendar: Lets the user pick a date from a monthly calendar.
components.CalendarCell: Holds one day in a row of the calendar grid.
components.CalendarCellTrigger: Lets the user select a single day of the calendar.
components.CalendarGrid: Lays out the days of one month in a grid.
components.CalendarGridBody: Holds the weeks of the calendar grid.
components.CalendarGridHead: Holds the row of weekday names above the calendar days.
components.CalendarGridRow: Groups the days of one week in the calendar grid.
components.CalendarHeadCell: Labels one column of the calendar grid with a weekday name.
components.CalendarHeader: Groups the heading and month navigation above the calendar grid.
components.CalendarHeading: Shows the month and year the calendar currently displays.
components.CalendarNextButton: Lets the user move the calendar to the next month.
components.CalendarPrevButton: Lets the user move the calendar to the previous month.
